description: Returns the API schema (options, events, methods, renderers) for a Mobiscroll component. Two-step, token-efficient flow: (1) call WITHOUT names to get a compact index - every entity as name + kind + tsType + a one-line summary. (2) Review the index, then call AGAIN with names:[...] to get the full details (complete description, default value, related entities) for only the entities you will actually use. Optionally pass kind to narrow to one entity type. The full schema is large, so prefer this two-step flow over pulling everything.

component.description: Bare lowercase component ID, regardless of framework (e.g., "datepicker", "select", "popup"). Do NOT include framework-specific prefixes or casing - use "eventcalendar" not "mbsc-eventcalendar" (Angular), "MbscEventcalendar" (Vue), or "Eventcalendar" (React). For Eventcalendar, append the variant suffix: "eventcalendar.base", "eventcalendar.agenda", "eventcalendar.scheduler", "eventcalendar.timeline", "eventcalendar.calendarview". Use listComponents to discover valid IDs.

framework.description: Framework to get the schema for. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

kind.description: Optional filter: return only entities of this kind. Works with or without names.

names.description: Detail tier: entity names (as shown in the index) to return in full. Omit on the first call to get the compact index; then call again with the handful of names you need. Names not found are reported in query.notFound.

name: getComponentSchema
title: Get Component API Schema
